dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.1:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point from the melon slope to the rostrum line.
